Defines the owner-aware single-object permission behavior, including owner bypass and guardian permission checking for non-owners.
Defines the authenticated-user model permissions required for POST, including add_note, view_document, and change_document.
Loads the target document, including its owner, before applying document-level authorization checks.
Applies the owner-aware view_document check to the target document before handling notes.
For POST, requires the owner-aware change_document check on the bound document before note creation.
Shows that the owner-aware check permits the owner, permits unowned documents, or otherwise requires the specified object permission.
Creates the note only after the POST authorization checks succeed.
